title: Deprecated or superseded governed parameters are not used as active authority
test_intent: Determine whether deprecated or superseded governed shared parameters remain traceable without being used for new governed information unless an approved transition or deviation explicitly permits temporary use.

applicability.applies_when: The tested model, template, family, exchange, or registry view contains a parameter identity that is deprecated or superseded in the applicable Shared Parameter Registry version.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No deprecated or superseded governed parameter appears in the tested scope.

required_evidence: applicable Shared Parameter Registry version and entry status
observed parameter GUIDs in the tested scope
approved transition, replacement mapping, or deviation record where temporary legacy use is claimed
replacement parameter identity where the registry declares supersession

result_logic.pass: No deprecated or superseded governed parameter is used as active semantic authority, or any temporary legacy use is covered by an explicit governed transition/deviation with traceable replacement handling.
result_logic.fail: A deprecated or superseded governed parameter is used for new or active governed information without an approved transition/deviation, or a declared replacement is bypassed without governed justification.
result_logic.not_applicable: No deprecated or superseded governed parameter appears in the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable registry version, observed GUID inventory, or transition/deviation evidence is insufficient to determine whether legacy use is permitted.

provenance.migration_note: Closes the deprecated-parameter QA hook from GAP-S8-01 and adapts the useful lifecycle concept in STAR-T-GATE Inbox #8 without importing its duplicate lane/citizenship model.
